definitions.accuracy: Overall fraction of correct predictions on the locked test split.
definitions.macro_f1: Unweighted mean of per-class F1; equal importance to all nine classes.
definitions.weighted_f1: F1 averaged across classes weighted by class support on the test split.
definitions.balanced_accuracy: Multiclass balanced accuracy = average recall across the nine classes.
definitions.mcc: Multiclass Matthews correlation coefficient over the nine-class confusion matrix.

limitations.note: Additional test metrics are for transparent reporting of the frozen GradientBoosting evaluation only; they were not used for model selection.

feature_extraction.scope: validation + disassembly + CFG + fingerprint/opcode features + pruned155 vector ordering

end_to_end_inference_internal.scope: full analyze_runtime_bytecode with preloaded GradientBoosting bundle (no per-call model disk reload)

throughput.scope: sequential end-to-end analyze_runtime_bytecode with preloaded model
throughput.excludes: application startup and model loading time (bundle preloaded before timed loop)

http_inference.scope: HTTP request-response to local /api/analyze (separate from internal backend timing)

bytecode_workload.source: locked test split contracts with readable valid runtime bytecode files

one_vs_rest_from_saved_confusion_matrix.scope: One-vs-rest per-vulnerability-class rates on the nine seed classes. Not benign-versus-malicious detection rates.

definitions.tp_fp_tn_fn: One-vs-rest counts from the saved 9x9 confusion matrix.
definitions.fpr: FP / (FP + TN); one-vs-rest per class; 0 if denominator is 0.
definitions.fnr: FN / (TP + FN); one-vs-rest per class; 0 if denominator is 0.
definitions.f1: 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall); 0 if denominator is 0.
definitions.macro_averages: Unweighted mean of per-class rate metrics only; counts are not averaged.

cm_derived_note: one_vs_rest_from_saved_confusion_matrix is computed from phase5_test_gb_pruned155.json only; no model load, fit, or predict.

definitions.parent_correct: Parent frozen-model prediction equals parent ground-truth label.
definitions.child_correct: Child frozen-model prediction equals child ground-truth label.
definitions.label_retention: Child prediction equals the known vulnerability label.
definitions.prediction_changed: Child prediction differs from parent prediction.
definitions.confidence: Class probabilities from frozen GradientBoosting predict_proba; true_label_prob_delta_child_minus_parent is child minus parent probability on the known label.

cohort.skew_note: 20 of 26 variants belong to a single parent

variant_level.aggregation: unweighted mean across all child variants

parent_level.aggregation: unweighted mean of per-parent rates so the parent with many variants does not dominate
